items.sentence: The fraction of blood the left ventricle ejects each beat. Sources differ on the lower limit of normal: British Society of Echocardiography reporting categories treat above 55% as normal, while the BHF and NHS England describe 50% or more as normal. Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction is defined as 40% or less.
items.note: NHS guidance sheet reproduces BSE-style bands (normal >55, borderline 50-54, impaired 36-49, severe <35). NHS England glossary: 50% or higher normal. BHF HF page: 40% or less reduced. NHS England HFpEF tool coding table: HFrEF <=40, HFmrEF 41-49. ASE/EACVI limits (52/54) also differ; not stated on page.

items.sentence: Ejection fraction well below normal -> Significantly reduced pumping; heart-failure treatment is considered
items.note: Qualitative rewrite of 'Ejection fraction 30% ... start heart-failure treatment'; no number kept.
